title: Cross-Leads: Weekly Operational Spotlight & Open Issues
content:
Attendees: Aisha (host), Marcus, Sofia, Ethan, Lina, Raj

Purpose: quick cross-team sync to highlight operational risks, decisions needed this week, and owners for follow-ups. Keep it pragmatic — 45 minutes.

Top-line summary:
- Rolling canary for v2.14 of the serving runtime is at 28% traffic in prod EU; latency regressions observed on long-context GPT-like config (~50–100 token tail). Root cause investigation in progress (perf team + infra).
- Dedicated capacity forecast for Q1 shows 12% shortfall vs committed customers if current autoscale profile unchanged. Capacity/infra needs decision this week.
- Observability: new trace sampling config landed in observability service but missing a tag used by Console dashboards; ETA fix today.

Agenda items discussed:
1) Serving runtime canary (owner: Marcus)
   - Symptoms: p95 token latency on long-context requests spiked ~18% after kernel swap PR (see linked PR). Repro locally with synthetic workload but not with all config flags.
   - Hypothesis: kernel selection path accidentally disables async-kv prefetch on specific quantized kernels.
   - Action: Marcus to revert kernel selection change in canary for EU only by EOD 12/09 if perf team cannot provide a hotfix. If revert occurs, monitor for 2 hours then proceed with staged rollout.
   - Risk: rollback will slightly increase token cost; communicate to finance/ops.

2) Dedicated capacity commit vs forecast (owner: Sofia)
   - Data: current autoscale policy keeps avg headroom at 10% for cost reasons; committed customers require ~22% headroom for SLA buffer. Forecast model indicates need for +3 A100-equivalent units in US and +2 in EU for Jan peak.
   - Options discussed: (A) increase baseline reserved nodes (cost +$X/mo), (B) temporarily raise burst capacity for Jan only, (C) negotiate customers for relaxed throughput SLO for Jan.
   - Decision: Sofia to prepare cost vs risk memo and recommendation by 12/10; leadership will triage on 12/11. Finance loop-in: Raj.

3) Console dashboard missing trace tag (owner: Ethan)
   - Root cause: observability pipeline mapping omitted new route_label field introduced in route-ops change. Dashboards using "route_label" return <unknown>.
   - Fix: quick mapper patch deployed to staging; Ethan to promote to prod after 1 hour canary. Expected resolution 12/09 morning.

4) Private deployment onboarding checklist gaps (owner: Lina)
   - Feedback from recent customer POC: KMS integration docs unclear, sample HSM config missing. Also need a clearer matrix for supported quantization+hardware combos.
   - Action: Lina to create a short playbook (2 pages) and a one-click checklist in Console -> Private Deployments by 12/17. Seq: doc in Confluence -> small customer-facing PDF -> notify Solutions Eng.

Open decisions needing leadership input:
- Autoscale policy change to increase baseline headroom for reserved capacity (expected decision 12/11).
- Communication tone for customer-facing note if we revert canary (ops vs product). Product recommends a transparent note; sales prefers minimal detail. Leadership to align.

Action items (owner / due / notes):
- Marcus: prepare revert plan and monitoring runbook for EU canary (due 2026-12-09 EOD). If revert enacted, postmortem draft due 12/12.
- Sofia: cost vs risk memo for Q1 dedicated capacity (due 2026-12-10). Include sensitivity to 10–30% traffic variance.
- Ethan: promote observability mapper patch to prod after canary (due 2026-12-09 AM). Confirm Console dashboards reflect route_label.
- Lina: Private deployment onboarding playbook + HSM sample config (due 2026-12-17). Share with SEs for review.
- Raj: notify Finance and schedule 30-min sync on dedicated capacity budget (due 2026-12-11).
- Aisha: draft customer-facing comms templates for both rollback and degraded perf scenarios (due 2026-12-10).

Parking lot / low priority:
- Evaluate opportunity to add synthetic long-context load tests to CI (tentative owner: perf-team, timeframe: Q1).
- Revisit model quantization support matrix for private deployments (add to backlog).

Notes / friction points raised:
- Cross-team visibility: teams want a single source-of-truth for active rollouts + canary status. Action: Aisha to scope a lightweight Console widget (mockup request) by 12/15.
- Oncall handoffs: SRE noted ambiguity on who owns graceful degradation policy for model-fallbacks. Proposed: add "fallback-policy" owner in runbooks; SRE to propose owners by 12/14.

Quick intel / FYIs:
- Customer X POC in APAC showing improved latency using new cache config — Solutions Eng will capture configuration and test across EU/US clusters.
- Upcoming holiday schedule: reduced staffing Dec 24–26; advise teams to avoid large rollouts that week unless emergency.

Decisions captured during meeting:
- No immediate full revert yet; proceed with narrow EU rollback plan if hotfix not ready by EOD 12/09.
- Leadership to review Sofia's memo on 12/11 before any budget commit.

Follow-ups / next meeting:
- Next cross-leads sync: 2026-12-15 09:30 PT. Proposed focus: postmortem review (if rollback), Q1 capacity decisions, and Console widget mockups.

Raw notes / snippets from discussion (informal):
- "If we keep pushing kernel swaps without proper perf benchmarks, we keep firefighting instead of stabilizing" — SRE
- "Customers sign up because our predictable latency is a feature — that makes the dedicated capacity question more than just cost" — Product
- TODO: someone add JIRA ticket to record rollback playbook and link to incident channel.

References:
- Runtime rollout PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/487
- Rollout plan: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Runtime+Rollout+Plan
- Forecast model: JIRA-8742

Document notes: quick-capture style; will refine into a formal staff brief if significant postmortem or budget decisions occur.
